text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Whooooa! Tohoku dirt! Tohoku air!<n>Lend me your
poooweeer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As if her prayers were answered,<n>Agnes Digital
claims today's crown<n>with a turbulent display of
skill.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You did it, Digital! And your winn'n<n>concert was the
cat's pajamas!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Wuhuhuh! What a beautiful<n>compliment!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It was all because of your support<n>that I could
assume my<n>power-level-530,000 final form! It was
like running in heaven!

text_block_list.name: Local Umamusume Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Wow, those centr'l runners really let<n>it rip! I've
never seen anyone run so<n>fast!

text_block_list.name: Local Umamusume Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
That was Agnes Digital, wasn't it?<n>She's got
herself a new fan!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Whuh?!

text_block_list.name: Local Umamusume Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
There she is! Umm... Digital? Would<n>y'mind if I get a
handshake?

text_block_list.name: Local Umamusume Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
You were so amaz'n! I wanna shake<n>your hand
too! Oh, 'n after that, can I<n>get your autograph?!

text_block_list.name: Local Umamusume Spectator E
text_block_list.text: You were far out in today's race! Youwere like whooosh 'cross the track. Iwanna run like you someday!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hehe. You're super popular, Digital.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Wh-whoa! P-popular? ...Popular???<n>Me????!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
T-T-Trainer, what do I do with all this<n>pure and
innocent adoration?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I don't deserve to be the apple ofsuch pure eyes! I'm supposed to beadoring them!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what do I do? My brain might<n>short-circuit at
any moment—
choice_data_list: A good fan doesn't let her oshis down, right?
A good fan doesn't let her oshis down, right?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hrngh!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
You're right! Nothing is more<n>important than my
oshis! If it's what<n>they want, I'll shake their hands
like<n>my life depends on it and pour my<n>entire soul
into signing those<n>autographs!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
What are my hesitation and<n>embarrassment but
trifles in<n>comparison?!

text_block_list.name: Local Umamusume Spectator C
text_block_list.text: Thanks a million for the handshake,<n>Digital!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: No, thank you! I won't be washingthis hand for a while!

text_block_list.name: Local Umamusume Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
Haha! You're a hoot, y'know that?<n>You'd better
wash your hands! At<n>least, b'fore you eat.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Gasp... Wheeze... ♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer. Heaven... is in Morioka...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad you seem to be hav'ng fun,<n>Digital. Come
back to Morioka soon,<n>y'hear! ♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Oh, you know I will!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Agnes Digital's regional trip<n>ends up a
great success.
